272|9722811b.name: Chef Grual
272|9722811b.text: Hello, hello!  Welcome to my kitchen, m'lady!  This is where all of the Scarlet Raven Tavern's finest delicacies are made.  Ah, just smell the wonderful aroma!

277042|589a8d2d.name: Bezza Shearshave
277042|589a8d2d.text:
Welcome, friend, to the barbershop! Come for a cut? A coloring? Something else, perhaps?

We can groom facial hair, perform piercings, ink night elf tattoos, anything you might need!

Have a seat and we'll get right to work. You're only moments away from a new, more attractive you...

1138-progress.name: Gubber Blump
1138-progress.text:
...lemon crab, whipper root crab, and Ironforge surprise crab.  That's about it.

Oh, hello there $N.  Do you have them fine crab chunks I was telling you about?
1138-progress.title: Fruit of the Sea

1141-progress.name: Gubber Blump
1141-progress.text:
There's plenty of good dishes you use Darkshore groupers for.  They're good to eat, but I think it's more fun catching them.

You caught any Darkshore groupers yet?
1141-progress.title: The Family and the Fishing Pole

1579-progress.name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
1579-progress.text: Did you find my gaffer jacks, $N?  Without my gaffer jacks I can't tune my stintle pegs!
1579-progress.title: Gaffer Jacks

1580-progress.name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
1580-progress.text: Did you find any electropellers?  I'll need them if I'm to continue my research on duck decoys...
1580-progress.title: Electropellers

79008-complete.name: Unknown
79008-complete.text: As you stumble upon the remnants of yet another charred corpse, your gaze falls upon a message secured to a wooden plank.
79008-complete.title: ... and that note you found

79192-accept.name: Unknown
79192-accept.text: The note begins, "Mission said they were both making deliveries for New Plague. Looks like simple apothecary accidents to me. Find my cozy spot in the mountains between The Barrens and Desolace if you want a safe place to talk."
79192-accept.title: Stepping Stones

944-progress.name: Scrying Bowl
944-progress.text:
The Master's Glaive, $N.

Go there, then speak with me again.
944-progress.title: The Master's Glaive

947-progress.name: Barithras Moonshade
947-progress.text: Do you have my mushrooms, $N?  Have you been to the cave?
947-progress.title: Cave Mushrooms

966-progress.name: Balthule Shadowstrike
966-progress.text: Have you found any more of their scrolls? I should be able to piece together a larger picture of the cult if you can find them.
966-progress.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

97914-accept.name: Thundris Windweaver
97914-accept.text:
Auberdine is a humble place, $c. You will not hear its name spoken in the boughs of Darnassus. Most reference only what the Sundering took from us--the thriving cities of Ameth'Aran, Bashal'Aran, and... Lathar'Lazal.

Yet Auberdine remains in their shadow.

I would see our work here recognized. A new vessel connects us to the kingdom of Stormwind, bringing life and supplies to our shores. I beseech you join its next voyage, and bring this letter to a $r called Baros Alexston.

Make our home known.
97914-accept.title: Expanding Horizons

97926-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
97926-progress.text: You have returned. What news comes from Stormwind?
97926-progress.title: Making Do

98013-accept.name: Arbal
98013-accept.text:
Steel yourself for your time in the ruins, young one... you will not be granted free passage there.

Scores of cursed Highborne, now known as naga, roam the once great city. Travel northeast and dispatch them from this land.

What they once were... is no more. If they aid the Twilight's Hammer, they can bring only further pain to the forests that once gave them shelter.

War is what they seek, $c. War... is what we will bring.
98013-accept.title: Swelling Forces

98042-accept.name: Unknown
98042-accept.text:
<As you tear away the single page from the Twilight Tome, a foreboding voice floods your mind, uninvited.>

They have failed.

You will be forgotten.

They will lose the eye they gained.
98042-accept.title: It's All Fun and Games Until...

98042-complete.name: Thundris Windweaver
98042-complete.text:
<Thundris does not speak for some time.>

This bears the mark of an ancient evil, $c. I will see it brought to Darnassus at once for further study.

Ande'thoras-ethil.
98042-complete.title: It's All Fun and Games Until...

98042-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
98042-progress.text: You look troubled. I am listening.
98042-progress.title: It's All Fun and Games Until...

982-progress.name: Gorbold Steelhand
982-progress.text: The captains of those ships were good night elves, and they deserve a better fate than they were given. Perhaps tending to their personal effects will be the best way to put their spirits to rest.
982-progress.title: Deep Ocean, Vast Sea
